description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier called GatewayTrustPromptAlert, which manages displaying an alert for trusting a gateway connection. It interacts with a GatewayConnectionController to handle trust prompts, and provides an extension to the View protocol for easy attachment of this alert.

classes.name: GatewayTrustPromptAlert
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that presents an alert prompting the user to trust a gateway during TLS connection.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the view with an alert based on the trust prompt. It displays trust confirmation or cancellation options.

methods.name: gatewayTrustPromptAlert
methods.description: An extension method on View that applies the GatewayTrustPromptAlert modifier.
